rem Deep-ML 17: K-Means Clustering
rem https://www.deep-ml.com/problems/17

use numbers
use sequences
use stats

rem Assign points to their nearest centroid and recompute cluster means.
fun Points K InitialCentroids Max k_means
  Samples = Points real
  Centroids = InitialCentroids real
  N = Points len
  fun Centroids step
    Labels = array shape N fill 0
    for i in 0 till N
      Point = Samples i
      Best = 0

      D = Point - Centroids 0
      BestDist = D * D sum

      for c in 1 till K
        D = Point - Centroids c
        Dist = D * D sum

        if Dist less BestDist
          BestDist = Dist
          Best = c
        end
      end

      Labels i = Best
    end

    Next = Centroids copy

    for c in 0 till K
      Mask = Labels equal c
      Cluster = Samples Mask #

      if Cluster len greater 0
        Next c = Cluster mean axis 0
      end
    end

    return Next
  end

  fun Prev done Next
    return Prev Next equal rank 2
  end

  Result = Centroids step repeat Max till done
  return Result round 4
end

rem https://www.deep-ml.com/problems/41

use sequences

fun A' K P S simple_conv2d
  W = K shape
  B' = A window W stride S padding P
  return B * K sum rank 2
end

rem Deep-ML 23: Softmax
rem https://www.deep-ml.com/problems/23

use numbers

rem Normalize scores with stable exp.
fun X softmax
  Shift' = X - (X max)
  Exps = Shift exp
  return Exps / (Exps sum)
end

rem Deep-ML 39: Log Softmax
rem https://www.deep-ml.com/problems/39

use numbers

fun Scores log_softmax
  Shift = Scores - (Scores max)
  Normalizer = Shift exp sum log
  return Shift - Normalizer round 4
end

rem Deep-ML 15: Gradient Descent
rem https://www.deep-ml.com/problems/15

use linalg
use numbers
use sequences

rem Fit linear coefficients with a fixed number of gradient updates.
fun X Y Rate Steps linear_regression
  Shape = X shape
  YShape = Y shape
  if Shape len not equal 2
    .DimensionMismatch raise
  end
  if YShape len not equal 1
    .DimensionMismatch raise
  end

  M = Shape 0
  N = Shape 1
  if YShape 0 not equal M
    .DimensionMismatch raise
  end

  Features = X real rank 0
  Targets = Y real rank 0
  Theta = array shape N fill 0.0

  for Step in 0 till Steps
    Pred = Features matmul Theta
    Error = Pred - Targets

    Grad' = Features matmul Error axis 0 0
    Grad' = Grad / (M real)

    Theta -= Rate * Grad
  end

  return Theta round 4
end
